notes: Energized Barriers removes Paralyzing Shots' snare component from the Mage.
Greater Invisibility avoids selected Hatchling debuffs and Zul'jan's Boneslicer without causing the boss to retarget; line of sight Blood Sacrifice.
Spellsteal can take the beetles' Spiny Shield.
Greater Invisibility or Blink escapes Bloodthorn Roots; Greater Invisibility also reduces the final boss's throw count during Thrash.
Remove Curse dispels Insatiable Hunger from an ally.
Greater Invisibility breaks the Feast of Misery channel when the Mage is selected.
Remove Curse answers Curse of Doom on the Mage or an ally.
Greater Invisibility breaks selected Drain Life channels; Blink can cross Malefic Waves while carrying the Broom objective.
Greater Invisibility cancels the final boss's Void Cascade targeting when timed for the Mage.
Spellsteal removes Accumulate Charge; Energized Barriers removes Slither Strike's snare.
Greater Invisibility or Ring of Frost breaks Arrow Barrage, Blink escapes A Knot of Snakes, and Polymorph can break Temple Disruptor channels.
Spellsteal removes Bound by Shadow and Captain's Bulwark; Remove Curse answers Hex.
Energized Barriers removes Frost Shock snares. Greater Invisibility cancels selected casts or channels and removes Dark Revelations; Ring of Frost controls susceptible leap and fear enemies.
Spellsteal removes Blaze of Glory and Stormcloud Barrier; no dungeon-specific use is asserted for the other tracked axes.

recommendations: Talent Supernova to interrupt a cluster of Ascendant casts.
Swap immediately and kill the Voidbound Emissary; no dedicated utility talent is required.
Use Mage mobility to collect partner orbs and aim your own orb toward an ally.
Remove Curse clears the eligible effect from the Mage or an ally; Energized Barriers provides a self-only alternative through the affix's snare component.

provenance.description: Original structured summary of Porom's Patch 12.1.0 Arcane Mage dungeon utility and affix recommendations. Talent strings, gear, and performance rankings are intentionally excluded.
